title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named Irving destinations on campus-adjacent and nearby corridors, each with one documented reason to go.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of Dallas Cistercian Abbey
cards.title: A monastery on Cistercian Road
cards.subtitle: Cistercian Road corridor, across from the University of Dallas
cards.notes: Use the abbey’s official tour page to orient yourself before visiting; its published address is 3550 Cistercian Road in Irving.
cards.short_summary: A documented monastic landmark directly across from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Our Lady of Dallas Cistercian Abbey lists its address as 3550 Cistercian Road, Irving, Texas 75039.
cards.access_notes: Consult the abbey directly for current visitor arrangements.

cards.title: The school across from UD
cards.subtitle: Cistercian Road corridor, across from the University of Dallas
cards.notes: Spot the neighboring preparatory school from the Cistercian Road corridor; its official location page explicitly identifies it as across from UD.
cards.short_summary: A named neighboring campus with a verified UD connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Cistercian Preparatory School states that it is located in Irving across from the University of Dallas and lists 3660 Cistercian Road.
cards.access_notes: This is an operating school; observe posted campus access rules.

cards.title: Four galleries on MacArthur
cards.subtitle: North MacArthur Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition calendar, then allow time for the four galleries and outdoor sculpture garden at this 10-acre arts complex.
cards.short_summary: A multi-gallery arts stop with an outdoor sculpture garden.
cards.evidence_claim: Irving Arts Center has four galleries, two theaters, and an outdoor sculpture garden at 3333 N. MacArthur Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and performances vary; check the center’s current schedule before going.

cards.title: Practice on Shady Grove
cards.subtitle: East Shady Grove Road corridor
cards.notes: Bring clubs or use the practice facility; the public course has multiple teeing areas and sits just off the Trinity River’s West Fork.
cards.short_summary: A public-course and practice-facility option on Shady Grove.
cards.evidence_claim: Irving Golf Club at 2000 E. Shady Grove Road is a par-71 course with multiple teeing areas and a practice facility.
cards.access_notes: Tee times and course use may require payment or reservation; verify directly.

cards.title: A river overlook on Riverside
cards.subtitle: Riverside Drive corridor
cards.notes: Start at the park’s Riverside Drive address for a 1.5-mile trail, picnic pavilion, birdwatching, and views over the river.
cards.short_summary: A named trailhead with a short documented route and river overlook.
cards.evidence_claim: Bird's Fort Trail Park at 5756 Riverside Drive has a mile-and-a-half trail, picnic pavilion, birdwatching, and a river overlook.
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and follow posted park and trail guidance.

cards.entity_name: Jackie Townsell Bear Creek Heritage Center
cards.title: Three museums on Jackson
cards.subtitle: Jackson Street corridor, west of Belt Line Road
cards.notes: Plan around the center’s current hours or an appointment, then visit its three museums and Native Plant Garden for Bear Creek history.
cards.short_summary: A three-museum history site documenting the Bear Creek community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jackie Townsell Bear Creek Heritage Center at 3925 Jackson Street contains three museums about Bear Creek and the African-American experience.
cards.source_title: Jackie Townsell Bear Creek Heritage Center
cards.access_notes: The official visitor page advises checking updated hours; appointments are available upon request.

cards.title: Nine bronzes on O’Connor
cards.subtitle: North O’Connor Boulevard corridor, Williams Square Plaza
cards.notes: Walk Williams Square Plaza to see Robert Glen’s nine bronze mustangs; pair it with the adjacent sculpture exhibit during its posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A plaza-scale sculpture installation with an adjacent interpretive exhibit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mustangs of Las Colinas are nine bronze mustangs in Williams Square Plaza; the adjacent Mustang Sculpture Exhibit has free admission.
cards.access_notes: The exhibit publishes Wednesday–Friday and Saturday hours; confirm before relying on them.

cards.title: Canal bridges by Las Colinas
cards.subtitle: Las Colinas Boulevard corridor, Las Colinas Urban Center
cards.notes: Follow the public-facing canal area for views of waterfalls and vine-covered bridges as it connects through the Las Colinas Urban Center.
cards.short_summary: A documented canal route connecting to Lake Carolyn.
cards.evidence_claim: Mandalay Canal connects with Lake Carolyn and winds through restaurants, shops, hotels, residences, and office buildings.
cards.source_title: Mandalay Canal Attractions | Restaurants, Shops & Hotels
cards.access_notes: Stay on publicly accessible walkways and follow posted property rules.

cards.title: Lake Carolyn paths at Water Street
cards.subtitle: Lake Carolyn Parkway corridor, Las Colinas
cards.notes: Use the public pathways at Water Street to reach Lake Carolyn views; the development is documented as a mixed-use destination on the lake’s shore.
cards.short_summary: A lakefront mixed-use destination with public-facing pathways.
cards.evidence_claim: Water Street is a mixed-use development on the shores of Lake Carolyn with a park and pathways for public access and views.
cards.source_title: Attractions in Irving | Dining, Museums & Hiking Trails
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses have separate hours and purchase requirements.

cards.title: The outdoor plaza on Las Colinas
cards.subtitle: West Las Colinas Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the event calendar before going; the 17-acre complex includes an outdoor plaza and stage surrounded by indoor food and retail spaces.
cards.short_summary: A large mixed-use entertainment complex with an outdoor plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: Toyota Music Factory is a 17-acre development with an 8,000-seat indoor-outdoor amphitheater and food and retail space around an outdoor plaza and stage.
cards.source_title: Toyota Music Factory Events in Irving
cards.access_notes: Event admission, venue rules, and business hours vary; review the specific event or business page.
